📜 Storyline

Rapunzel is a princess with magical, golden hair who has spent her entire life locked away in a tower by Mother Gothel. Dreaming of seeing the floating lanterns that appear every year on her birthday, she gets an unexpected chance to escape when a charming thief named Flynn Rider enters her life.

Together, Rapunzel and Flynn embark on an adventure filled with danger, laughter, and unexpected feelings. Along the way, Rapunzel discovers the truth about her past and learns that the world is far bigger and more beautiful than she ever imagined.

Plot:
Based on the viral book series by Elle Kennedy, the show is set at Briar University and follows the lives of the elite college ice hockey team. Season 1, titled The Deal, focuses on Hannah Wells, a music major who is seemingly the only girl on campus not interested in the hockey team. When star captain Garrett Graham needs to pass a philosophy class to keep his spot on the team, he strikes a deal with Hannah: she tutors him, and he helps her win over her crush by pretending to date her. As their fake relationship plays out in the public eye, the lines between their agreement and reality begin to blur, forcing both to confront their past traumas and true feelings.
Casting:
[Ella Bright, Belmont Cameli, Josh Heuston, Mika Abdalla, Khobe Clarke, Antonio Cipriano, Jalen Thomas Brooks, Steve Howey]
Crew:

Writers: Lousia Levy, Gina Fattore (Based on the novels by Elle Kennedy)
Executive Producers: Jenny Han, Hope Hartman, Mads Hansen, Karen Rosenfelt
Production: Amazon MGM Studios
Trivia:
The series follows the "interconnected standalone" format of the books, much like Bridgerton, where each season focuses on a different couple while keeping the core friend group as the recurring characters.
.

•��"Northern Static"
•��des visuels inspirés de voyages nocturnes sans destination
Rien n’y paraît vraiment forcé. Les morceaux avancent doucement, portés par des mélodies aériennes et des textures électroniques qui donnent parfois l’impression d’observer une ville à travers une fenêtre embuée.
Ces derniers jours, plusieurs extraits ont commencé à circuler discrètement sur les réseaux. Quelques plans de routes désertes, des lumières perdues dans le brouillard et de courts fragments de nouvelles chansons. Pas assez pour comprendre l’ensemble, mais suffisamment pour éveiller la curiosité.
Et parfois, les projets les plus intéressants sont précisément ceux qui laissent un peu de mystère derrière eux.

📖 Story

Hurmat is a young woman from a highly restrictive family. Her father doesn't allow her to attend university, controlling almost every part of her life. She dreams of education and independence, eventually finding a way to step outside the boundaries imposed on her. 

The drama appears to go beyond a simple strict-family-girl story, exploring women's identity, freedom, marriage, family expectations and the right to make your own choices. 

And yes, Shahveer Jafry is making his television acting debut opposite Dananeer, which is probably the biggest curiosity around the show. 👀 

Cast also includes: Javed Sheikh, Ali Tahir, Anoushay Abbasi, Mohammad Ahmed, Sana Humayun and others. 

So the basic vibe is:

sheltered girl → education denied → breaks out of her controlled world → discovers freedom, love and the consequences that come with it. 🌿

And unlike a fluffy Dananeer-Shahveer romance, the teasers suggest this one is going for a much heavier social drama. 
